Professional Services – Expert Solutions for Your Business

We deliver trusted business consulting, accounting, and digital transformation services to help your company thrive. With over 15 years of experience, ProSolutions has partnered with more than 300 businesses across the Pacific Northwest.

Explore Our Services

Our Core Services

Comprehensive solutions tailored to your business needs

Business Consulting

Strategic guidance for growth, operational efficiency, and market positioning. Our consultants work with you to identify opportunities and overcome challenges.

  • Strategic planning

  • Market analysis

$150/hour

Minimum engagement: 10 hours

Accounting & Bookkeeping

Full-service accounting solutions including bookkeeping, tax preparation, payroll processing, and financial reporting for small to mid-sized businesses.

  • Monthly bookkeeping
  • Tax planning & filing
  • Payroll management
  • Financial statements
$1,200/month

Starting package for small businesses

Digital Transformation

Modernize your business with cloud solutions, software integration, cybersecurity assessments, and digital workflow automation.

  • Cloud migration
  • System integration
  • Cybersecurity review
  • Workflow automation
